item.title: Will back any decsion on Sunetra Pawar if family, party agree, says Fadnavis
item.description: The 62-year-old leader, who is not a member of either house of the Maharashtra legislature, will be elected as leader of the legislature wing of the Nationalist Congress Party

item.title: J&K: Army commander reviews counter-terror grid in Kishtwar amid anti-terror operation
item.description: Lt Gen Pratik Sharma, Northern Army Commander, commended troops hunting three Jaish-e-Mohammad terrorists in the Chatroo belt; mobile internet remains suspended

item.title: Djokovic and Alcaraz set up Australian Open final after marathon 5-set wins in semis
item.description: Djokovic eyes a record 25th major while Alcaraz chases a career Grand Slam after they overcame Jannik Sinner and Alexander Zverev respectively in the semifinals

item.title: Silver crashes 17 pc, gold falls 9 pc in futures trade in massive single-day fall
item.description: The sharp decline follows record highs on Thursday (Jan 29), driven by a stronger US dollar and reports of hawkish Kevin Warsh being nominated as the next US Federal Reserve chairman

item.title: US offers Venezuelan oil to India to cut Russian crude imports
item.description: After Trump’s tariffs, the US urges India to reduce Russian oil imports and resume buying Venezuelan crude amid Ukraine war concerns

item.title: Unaware of Sunetra Pawar's swearing-in as Maharashtra Dy CM, says Sharad Pawar

item.title: Thane EOW arrests trio for defrauding 11,000 investors of Rs 500 crore

item.title: Tirupati laddu: YSRCP slams TDP after SIT says no animal fat found
item.description: SIT report on TTD laddu ghee finds no animal fat but exposes a massive fake ghee scam, triggering a fresh political war of words between two parties

item.title: Ajit Pawar camp not keen on NCP merger talks, says Sharad Pawar
item.description: The merger of the two factions of the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) was scheduled to be announced on February 12, says Pawar

item.title: Will support rail projects in Kerala if environmentally, financially viable: Satheesan
item.description: The Congress leader said they had opposed the K-Rail project only after studying its Detailed Project Report, and that Sreedharan's proposal needed more detailed studies
